title: Threshold degree of flipped parity
statement: For every natural number $k$, the Boolean function on $\{-1,1\}^{k+1}$ that equals the parity of all $k+1$ coordinates except that its value at the all-ones input is flipped has a polynomial threshold representation of Fourier degree at most $k$.
